summary: New experimental component stagger — the fifth of ADR 0028's owned motion components, built on Presence (appear). The items present on the first render arrive in document order, each one --ui-stagger-step after the one before, with Presence's rise (or fade, by kind). Decided with the maintainer (2026-11-27): the delay caps at the sixth item — everything after it arrives with it — so a group of any length is in within 5 × step + --ui-duration-base. The delay is a transition-delay that applies only while data-presence is entering, so once an item settles a later hover, fade or exit on it is never held back; items added after mount arrive at once. No new token: --ui-stagger-step is already 0 at Reduced and Off, so the group arrives together there with no code. Three probes (no cap, delay left on after settling, later items delayed) each failed their named test.
